rationale.edition: The complete changed-files list shows every substantive change lives under web/src/enterprise/components/billings/ (plans.vue, proPlan.vue, enterprisePlan.vue plus their .spec.ts files). Only web/src/constants/config.ts (a comment-only addition) and the shared web/src/locales/languages/en-US.json strings sit outside that enterprise directory, and they exist solely to serve the enterprise billing feature. Enterprise-owned paths dominate, so the edition is enterprise.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The diff alters a user-facing UI flow (the billing/subscription plans page) with no docs/CI-only opt-out, and both feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are empty, so no explicit skip marker or tests-added label was present.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. plans.vue now maps pricing.json into per-plan price blocks, proPlan.vue renders pay-as-you-go vs annual-contract pricing tiles with a contact-sales action, enterprisePlan.vue renders a new price line, and the AI-credits card was redesigned — all user-visible behaviors worth verifying in the browser.
rationale.area: Billing/subscription is an enterprise settings/admin page, and the closest existing test folder is Management, which already holds sibling enterprise settings specs (logoManagement.spec.js, cipherKeys.spec.js, model-pricing.spec.js). There is no Billing folder, so Management is the nearest fit.
rationale.group: The Management testfolder shard is the closest existing matrix group for enterprise settings/admin specs; billingPlansPricing.spec.js should join it. If billing grows into its own shard later, the Engineer can split a Billing group, but Management is the correct home today.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs are in the diff. The only test files changed are Vitest unit specs (web/src/enterprise/components/billings/*.spec.ts and usage/UsageView.spec.ts), which are not E2E coverage and do not set existing_tests_in_diff. No tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ path is touched.
